title: Visibility in the Boolean Model on Harmonic Manifolds
summary: In Poisson Boolean models with deterministic ball grains, the directional visible range from an uncovered point is known to be exponentially distributed in Euclidean and real hyperbolic space. We show that the same phenomenon holds on every simply connected non-compact homogeneous harmonic manifold. The geometric mechanism behind this fact is the affine-linear growth of tube volumes around geodesic segments.
